## [ArrayList / LinkedList](https://java-px.bot.cd/java-language/02-collections/list)
> - ArrayList: dynamic array, O(1) get, O(n) insert/remove, grows 1.5x - LinkedList: doubly-linked, O(1) insert/remove at ends, O(n) get - fail-fast: ConcurrentModificationException when iterating while

## [HashMap 原理](https://java-px.bot.cd/java-language/02-collections/map)

## [Set / TreeSet](https://java-px.bot.cd/java-language/02-collections/set)
> - HashSet backed by HashMap (value is a dummy PRESENT object) - TreeSet: Red-Black Tree, sorted order, O(log n) - LinkedHashSet: insertion order, doubly-linked list + HashSet
